args: Assess a DIFFERENT grasp station shifted toward the exposed positive-world-x end, not the failed central descent. Request separated noncollinear interior top points u0,u1,u2 near this station and adjacent counter points c0,c1. Request a0,a1 at two separated heights on the positive-across long wall, and b0,b1 on the opposite wall, within the supplied contact segment. Use both views, depth-valid wall interiors and different heights, not fingers/background. consistent requires visible wall continuity from top toward support on BOTH local sides; unknown is not clear. Return edge_pixels at the four supplied upper-edge cross-section endpoints IN ORDER in one camera, or []/unknown. These are sampling locations, not material corners. Assess this changed open-finger approach independently; do not claim the prior stall cause is known. On retry use different samples or view. No contact yet.

historical_geometry.aperture_assumption: Symmetric prismatic joint separation less one transverse pad-size allowance is a conservative screening model, not measured inner-face clearance; fresh visible straddling is also required.
historical_geometry.p0_identity: White curled capital C beginning Cream near the upper end of the printed blue logo.
historical_geometry.geometry_scope: Revalidated historical footprint; target is historical, NOT correction authority. Actual-pose gates control closure; retreat requires its own review.
historical_geometry.guard_provenance: Historical guard, never reduced, plus measured top/support disagreement; current fit floor also retained.

result.explanation: The visible package and counter agree with the supplied observations. At the shifted station, the wrist view shows the positive-across wall and agentview shows the opposite wall continuing from their upper edges toward support. These local strips support the straight-wall hypothesis. No external obstruction is visible in the changed open-finger approach. The prior central stall cause remains unknown.

parameters.notes: Retry uses different samples, including a wider noncollinear top triangle. All requested names are returned. Wall samples use minimum-radius patches; validate depths and height separation and reject top/counter mixing, especially on the narrow opposite wall. Both visible wall strips support only the supplied local contact segment, not hidden geometry or global clearance. Edge samples retain the supplied endpoint order and are not material corners. Lower wrist-image occlusion is robot self-occlusion, not an external obstacle. Earlier raw images are unavailable for direct comparison. No contact, retention, closure authorization, or completion is established.
